name: JBLE-Langley
description: Home to Air Combat Command headquarters and the 633d Air Base Wing. A key East Coast fighter and command base in the Hampton Roads region supporting ACC and joint operations.

currentNotifications.title: Gate Access Reminders
currentNotifications.body: LaSalle Gate (Main) and Armistead Gate are primary 24/7 access points. Visitor Control Center at LaSalle Gate open 0700-1700 daily.

gates.name: LaSalle Gate (Main Gate)
gates.notes: Primary gate with Visitor Control Center (Bldg 5). Daily 0700-1700 for visitor processing and passes.
gates.address: LaSalle Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

gates.name: Armistead Gate (West)
gates.notes: 24/7 alternate access point. Useful for off-hours arrivals.
gates.address: Armistead Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

gates.name: King Street Gate
gates.notes: Secondary access point with limited hours.
gates.address: King Street Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

gates.name: Visitor Control Center (Bldg 5)
gates.notes: Day passes, visitor registration, and base access requests. Located outside LaSalle Gate.
gates.address: Bldg 5, outside LaSalle Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

resources.name: Langley Dining Facility (DFAC)
resources.description: Primary DFAC supporting ACC and 633 ABW personnel with full meal service and flight meals.
resources.hours: See posted meal hours at facility

resources.name: Langley Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Full-service Exchange with retail, services, and food court options.

resources.name: Langley Fitness Center
resources.description: Main fitness facility with cardio, weights, group exercise, and sports amenities.
resources.hours: See 633 FSS for current schedule; 24/7 access where available
resources.address: 230 E. Flight Line Rd, Langley AFB, VA 23665

resources.name: Military Housing Office (Langley)
resources.description: On-base family housing assignments and off-base referrals for JBLE-Langley.

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for unaccompanied personnel.

resources.name: Langley Lodging / Inns
resources.description: Temporary lodging and TLF for PCS arrivals and official travel. 24-hour arrival point.

resources.name: Airman & Family Readiness Center (A&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, EFMP, deployment preparation, and family programs.

resources.name: 633d Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs for JBLE-Langley.
resources.hours: See FSS directory for individual facility hours

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation / Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course, pools (indoor/outdoor), bowling, shooting range, and recreational programs through 633 FSS.

resources.name: 633d Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services for the Langley community.

primaryAction.title: Visitor Control Center (LaSalle Gate)
primaryAction.address: Bldg 5, outside LaSalle Gate, Langley AFB, Hampton, VA 23665

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records. REAL ID or equivalent required for base access. Sponsor required for visitors without DoD ID.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Report to Inns of Charleston / Langley Lodging for initial arrival. Contact Military Housing Office for family housing or Unaccompanied Housing for dorms.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 633 FSS, A&FRC, and official JBLE sites for in-processing and community support.
